faqs.q: Sec. 98-109. - Arvada Plaza and Independence Center Cooperation Agreement Credit.
faqs.a:
Notwithstanding any other provisions of this chapter, there shall be granted to each
               person obligated to remit the sales tax on retail sales transactions occurring at
               retail sales outlets on the property, described in Exhibits A* and B* to the Cooperation
               Agreement dated July 15, 2013, by and between the City of Arvada and the Arvada Urban
               Renewal Authority (the "agreement") and incorporated herein by this reference, a tax
               credit against collection of the tax equal to the amount of the retail sales fee paid
               to the public improvement company as described in the agreement. The amount of the
               credit shall not exceed the amount of the sales tax, but in any event not more than
               three percent on taxable sales. This credit shall terminate when the collection of
               the retail sales fee terminates. For purposes of this section, the term "retail sales
               fee" shall have the same meaning as the definition of "PIF" or "Public Improvement
               Fee" in the agreement, which fee is imposed on retail sales transactions occurring
               at retail sales outlets on the property. The credit authorized hereby shall be effective
               only upon the recording of the Public Improvement Company covenants described in the
               agreement, which, among other matters, shall create an obligation by retailers to
               collect and remit the retail sales fee to the public improvement company. At the option
               of the city, the city may function as the public improvement company.
(
Ord. No. 4396, § 2, 7-15-2013
)
*Note—
Exhibits A and B are not set out herein. Copies can be found in the city offices.
